scientific_integrity: The geometric proof supplies universal claims; finite independent convex-hull tests are corroborative only. Historical priority remains provisional and independent mathematical review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Established only for nondegenerate three-dimensional tetrahedra plus a single nonzero segment and q>0. No general-body or higher-dimensional theorem; archival originality assessment cannot exclude older unindexed polyhedral formulas.
summary: An exact fixed-relative-volume two-sided difference-body and normalized Godbersen mixed-volume spectrum for a tetrahedron plus one segment, including all equality directions and complete interval realizability.
title: Sharp Rogers–Shephard orientation spectrum for tetrahedral segment extrusions
